case_title: HARESH MOHANDAS RAJPUT v. STATE OF MAHARASHTRA
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment under Section 302 IPC and 10 years imprisonment under Section 376 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, a man, was convicted of the murder and rape of a 10-year-old girl. The victim was found dead inside the accused's house with blood stains under the cot. The prosecution relied on circumstantial evidence, including the presence of the victim's body in the accused's house, blood stains on the bedsheet and floor, and the absence of any explanation from the accused for how the victim's body arrived at his house. The accused claimed he had gone to a liquor shop, but this was found to be false. The victim's body was discovered by the police, and the medical report indicated sexual assault and strangulation as the cause of death. The trial court convicted the accused and sentenced him to life imprisonment for murder and 10 years for rape, with both sentences to run concurrently. The High Court upheld the conviction but enhanced the sentence to death, which was later overturned by the Supreme Court, restoring the life imprisonment sentence.
